---
title: "Claustrum Connectivity in Prematurity Specificity and Influence of CP-Cognition Associations"
author: "Jil Wendt"
format: html
editor: visual
editor_options: 
  chunk_output_type: console
---

Specificity and influence analyses for the FDR-significant associations between CP and cognition in preterm-born participants (Supplementary control and robustness analyses, section 5): ANT orienting and CP to right primary motor cortex (BLS adults); Bayley-III cognition and CP to left parietal associative cortex and right hippocampus (dHCP neonates). For each association: group x CP interaction in the full cohort (FDR across ROIs within outcome), leverage, Cook's distance and DFBETAS, re-fit after excluding participants with Cook's distance \> 4/n, leave-one-out analysis, and partial regression plots.

- Input: `data/adults_harmonized.csv`, `data/dHCP_CP_cog_ses.csv`
- Outputs:
  - `outputs/tables/Revision_interaction_influence_LOO_cognition_<date>.csv`: Tables S25 and S26 (results/interaction_influence_LOO_cognition.csv)
  - `outputs/figures/Revision314_partial_regression_all_<date>.png`: Supplementary Figure S9

## Load data BLS (adults)

```{r}
# --- Load data ---
dat <- read_delim(
  here("data", "adults_harmonized.csv"),
  delim = ";",
  trim_ws = TRUE,
  locale = locale(decimal_mark = ","),
  na = c(""," ","NA", "NaN", "n/a", "."),
  col_types = cols(
    Subject = col_character(),
    ID      = col_character()
  ),
  guess_max = 10000
) |> janitor::clean_names()

# --- recode and name important factors ---
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(case_when(
      groupcode == 0 ~ "FT",
      groupcode == 1 ~ "PT",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ), levels = c("FT", "PT")),
    
    sex = factor(case_when(
      sex == 1 ~ "Male",
      sex == 2 ~ "Female",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ), levels = c("Female", "Male"))
  )
```

### Adjust data and create subsets

```{r}
drop_vars <- c("id")

final_dat_CP <- dat %>%
  dplyr::select(-starts_with("cd_"), -all_of(drop_vars))

cp_vars <- grep("^cp_", names(final_dat_CP), value = TRUE)
cog_all <- c("wie_gesiq", "ant_alerting", "ant_orienting", "ant_congruency")
covars  <- c("age_at_scan", "sex")

# --- full sample (PT + FT), CP standardized with PT mean/SD ---
dat_BLS_full <- final_dat_CP %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(c(cp_vars, cog_all)), ~ {
      if (is.factor(.)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(.))) else as.numeric(.)
    }),
    dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(cp_vars),
                  ~ (.x - mean(.x[group == "PT"], na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(.x[group == "PT"], na.rm = TRUE))
  )

# --- checks ---
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(dat_BLS_full$subject))
```

# 2 Analysis

### Helper functions

```{r}
fit_family <- function(data, outcome, target_cp, family_cps, covars, min_n = 10) {
  purrr::map_dfr(family_cps, function(cp) {
    fml <- as.formula(paste(outcome, "~", paste(c(cp, covars), collapse = " + ")))
    df  <- tidyr::drop_na(data[, all.vars(fml)])
    if (nrow(df) < min_n) return(NULL)
    broom::tidy(lm(fml, data = df), conf.int = TRUE) %>%
      dplyr::filter(term == cp) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(conf.low  = estimate - 1.96 * std.error,
                    conf.high = estimate + 1.96 * std.error) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(n = nrow(df))
  }) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr")) %>%
    dplyr::filter(term == target_cp)
}

fit_within <- function(data, outcome, cp, covars) {
  fml <- as.formula(paste(outcome, "~", paste(c(cp, covars), collapse = " + ")))
  df  <- tidyr::drop_na(data[, c("subject", all.vars(fml))])
  list(fit = lm(fml, data = df), df = df)
}

# Leverage and influence per participant
influence_table <- function(fit, df, cp) {
  n <- nobs(fit)
  k <- length(coef(fit))
  tibble(
    subject    = df$subject,
    leverage   = hatvalues(fit),
    cooks_d    = cooks.distance(fit),
    dfbetas_cp = dfbetas(fit)[, cp]
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      flag_leverage = leverage   > 2 * k / n,
      flag_cooks    = cooks_d    > 4 / n,
      flag_dfbetas  = abs(dfbetas_cp) > 2 / sqrt(n)
    )
}

# Leave-one-out
loo_family <- function(data, df_target, outcome, target_cp, family_cps, covars, min_n = 10) {
  purrr::map_dfr(df_target$subject, function(id) {
    fit_family(dplyr::filter(data, subject != id), outcome, target_cp, family_cps, covars, min_n) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(dropped = id, .before = 1)
  })
}

# Group x CP interaction in the full sample
fit_interaction <- function(data, outcome, cp, covars) {
  fml <- as.formula(paste(outcome, "~", paste(c(paste("group *", cp), covars), collapse = " + ")))
  df  <- tidyr::drop_na(data[, c("subject", all.vars(fml))])
  fit <- lm(fml, data = df)
  
  tr     <- emmeans::emtrends(fit, ~ group, var = cp)
  slopes <- as.data.frame(summary(tr, infer = TRUE)) %>%
    dplyr::rename(slope = dplyr::ends_with(".trend")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(lower.CL = slope - 1.96 * SE, upper.CL = slope + 1.96 * SE)
  diff   <- as.data.frame(summary(pairs(tr, reverse = TRUE), infer = TRUE)) %>%   # PT - FT
    dplyr::mutate(lower.CL = estimate - 1.96 * SE, upper.CL = estimate + 1.96 * SE)
  
  list(fit = fit, df = df, slopes = slopes, diff = diff, n_by_group = table(df$group))
}
```

#### Wrapper to run all steps

```{r}
run_followup <- function(data_full, targets, family_cps, covars, min_n = 10) {
  data_PT <- dplyr::filter(data_full, group == "PT")
  ids     <- targets$target_id
  
  # reproduce within-PT result
  repro <- targets %>%
    mutate(res = purrr::map2(outcome, cp, ~ fit_family(data_PT, .x, .y, family_cps, covars, min_n))) %>%
    tidyr::unnest(res)
  
  # group x CP interaction (full sample)
  interactions <- purrr::map2(targets$outcome, targets$cp,
                              ~ fit_interaction(data_full, .x, .y, covars)) %>% purrr::set_names(ids)
  
  # leverage / influence (within PT)
  within <- purrr::map2(targets$outcome, targets$cp,
                        ~ fit_within(data_PT, .x, .y, covars)) %>% purrr::set_names(ids)
  infl   <- purrr::map2(within, targets$cp, ~ influence_table(.x$fit, .x$df, .y)) %>% purrr::set_names(ids)
  
  excl_cooks <- purrr::pmap_dfr(list(targets$outcome, targets$cp, infl, ids), function(outcome, cp, inf, id) {
    drop_ids <- inf$subject[inf$flag_cooks]
    fit_family(dplyr::filter(data_PT, !subject %in% drop_ids), outcome, cp, family_cps, covars, min_n) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(target_id = id, n_removed = length(drop_ids), .before = 1)
  })
  
  # leave-one-out (within PT)
  loo <- purrr::pmap(list(within, targets$outcome, targets$cp),
                     ~ loo_family(data_PT, ..1$df, ..2, ..3, family_cps, covars, min_n)) %>%
    purrr::set_names(ids)
  
  loo_summary <- purrr::imap_dfr(loo, ~ tibble(
    target_id        = .y,
    n_fits           = nrow(.x),
    beta_min         = min(.x$estimate),
    beta_max         = max(.x$estimate),
    p_max            = max(.x$p.value),
    p_fdr_max        = max(.x$p_fdr),
    n_fdr_sig        = sum(.x$p_fdr < 0.05),
    n_p_sig = sum(.x$p.value < 0.05),
    most_influential = .x$dropped[which.max(.x$p.value)]
  ))
  
  list(repro = repro, interactions = interactions, within = within, infl = infl,
       excl_cooks = excl_cooks, loo = loo, loo_summary = loo_summary, targets = targets)
}
```

#### Summary table helper

```{r}
fmt_ci <- function(est, lo, hi, d = 3) sprintf(paste0("%.", d, "f [%.", d, "f, %.", d, "f]"), est, lo, hi)

summarise_followup <- function(res, cohort, ix_fdr = NULL) {
  res$targets %>%
    dplyr::select(target_id, label) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Cohort = cohort, .before = 1) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(res$repro %>% dplyr::transmute(target_id,
                                                    `PT only: beta [95% CI]` = fmt_ci(estimate, conf.low, conf.high),
                                                    `PT only: t`             = round(statistic, 2),
                                                    `PT only: pFDR`          = signif(p_fdr, 4),
                                                    `PT only: N`             = n), by = "target_id") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(res$excl_cooks %>% dplyr::transmute(target_id,
                                                         `Cook's excl.: n removed`       = n_removed,
                                                         `Cook's excl.: beta [95% CI]`   = fmt_ci(estimate, conf.low, conf.high),
                                                         `Cook's excl.: pFDR`            = signif(p_fdr, 4)), by = "target_id") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(res$loo_summary %>% dplyr::transmute(target_id,
                                                          `LOO: beta range`     = sprintf("%.3f to %.3f", beta_min, beta_max),
                                                          `LOO: max pFDR`       = signif(p_fdr_max, 4),
                                                          `LOO: P < 0.05 fits` = paste0(n_p_sig, "/", n_fits),
                                                          `LOO: FDR-sig. fits`  = paste0(n_fdr_sig, "/", n_fits)), by = "target_id") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(purrr::imap_dfr(res$interactions, function(ix, id) {
      s <- ix$slopes; d <- ix$diff
      tibble(target_id = id,
             `Slope PT [95% CI]` = fmt_ci(s$slope[s$group == "PT"], s$lower.CL[s$group == "PT"], s$upper.CL[s$group == "PT"]),
             `Slope FT [95% CI]` = fmt_ci(s$slope[s$group == "FT"], s$lower.CL[s$group == "FT"], s$upper.CL[s$group == "FT"]),
             `Interaction: slope diff. PT-FT [95% CI]` = fmt_ci(d$estimate, d$lower.CL, d$upper.CL),
             `Interaction: t(df)` = sprintf("%.2f (%d)", d$t.ratio, as.integer(d$df)),
             `Interaction: p`     = signif(d$p.value, 4),
             `N (PT/FT)`          = paste0(ix$n_by_group["PT"], "/", ix$n_by_group["FT"]))
    }), by = "target_id") %>%
    { if (!is.null(ix_fdr)) dplyr::left_join(., ix_fdr, by = "target_id") else . } %>%
    { if (!is.null(ix_fdr)) dplyr::relocate(., `Interaction: pFDR`, .after = `Interaction: p`) else . } %>%
    dplyr::select(-target_id)
}
```

# 3 Summary table

```{r}
grid_ix <- function(data, outcomes, cps, covars) {
  tidyr::expand_grid(outcome = outcomes, cp = cps) %>%
    mutate(diff = purrr::map2(outcome, cp, ~ fit_interaction(data, .x, .y, covars)$diff)) %>%
    tidyr::unnest(diff) %>%
    group_by(outcome) %>%
    mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr")) %>%
    ungroup()
}
grid_dHCP <- grid_ix(dat_dHCP_full, unique(targets_dHCP$outcome), cp_vars_dHCP, covars_dHCP)
grid_BLS  <- grid_ix(dat_BLS_full,  unique(targets_BLS$outcome),  cp_vars,      covars)

ix_fdr <- dplyr::bind_rows(grid_BLS, grid_dHCP) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(target_id = paste(outcome, cp, sep = "__"),
                   `Interaction: pFDR` = round(p_fdr, 3))

summary_3.1.4 <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  summarise_followup(res_BLS,  "BLS (adults)",    ix_fdr),
  summarise_followup(res_dHCP, "dHCP (neonates)", ix_fdr)
)

outfile <- file.path(tab_dir, paste0("Revision_interaction_influence_LOO_cognition_", format(Sys.Date()), ".csv"))
readr::write_csv2(summary_3.1.4, outfile)
message("Saved: ", outfile)
```

# 4 Partial regression plots (Figure S9)

```{r}
plot_av <- function(res, panel_letters = NULL) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(res$targets))) {
    id <- res$targets$target_id[i]; cp <- res$targets$cp[i]; w <- res$within[[id]]
    car::avPlot(w$fit, variable = cp, id = FALSE, main = res$targets$label[i],
                xlab = paste0("Adjusted CP ", lbl(cp)),
                ylab = paste0("Adjusted ", lbl(res$targets$outcome[i])))
    if (!is.null(panel_letters))
      mtext(panel_letters[i], side = 3, line = 1.5, adj = 0,
            at = par("usr")[1] - 0.12 * diff(par("usr")[1:2]), font = 2, cex = 1.5)
  }
}

png(file.path(fig_dir, paste0("Revision314_partial_regression_all_", Sys.Date(), ".png")),
    width = 15, height = 5, units = "in", res = 300)
par(mfrow = c(1, 3))
plot_av(res_dHCP, panel_letters = c("A", "B"))
plot_av(res_BLS,  panel_letters = "C")
dev.off()
```
